entries: A creature can be immersed in frigid water for a number of minutes equal to its Constitution score before suffering any ill effects. Each additional minute spent in frigid water requires the creature to succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} level. Creatures with {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} or {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to Cold damage automatically succeed on the save, as do creatures that are naturally adapted to living in ice-cold water.
